## About

Virendra Chavan is a results-driven Python Full-Stack Developer with expertise in Django, FastAPI, React.js, Generative AI, RAG pipelines, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI API, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Docker, and AWS. He holds a B.Tech. in Computer Engineering from Abhinav Education Society's College of Engineering and Technology, Bhor, Maharashtra. He is available for full-time roles, freelance projects, and remote opportunities across India and worldwide.
